test_title: PYST 64: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Most of the committee / are here to / decide the fate of / this ancient building.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the plural verb "**are**" with the singular collective noun "**committee**."
 
• Collective nouns, when considered as a single entity, typically require **a singular verb.**
 
• The correct phrase should be "**Most of the committee is here to**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Most of the committee **is here to** decide the fate of this ancient building."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2: "Most of the committee" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "decide the fate of"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "this ancient building."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
